name: services/apiref/method_index
description: Get a list of USOS API methods with brief descriptions.
brief_description: Get a list of USOS API methods with brief descriptions.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
A list of dictionaries, each of which contains one API method description in the following format:
  • name - name of a method,
  • brief_description - plain-text, brief (usually single sentenced) description of what the method does.
